hero.title: GD Goenka University
hero.summary: GD Goenka University’s School of Agricultural Sciences offers undergraduate agriculture and specialist postgraduate study on the Gurugram-Sohna campus. Its course page explains a test-and-interview admission route, while the school records recent activities on crop water use, soil quality and agricultural technology.

overview.heading: Agricultural science with a documented application route
paragraphs: The four-year B.Sc. Agriculture page describes study across crop production and protection, including plant disease, insects, weeds and nutrient problems. The school also lists master’s study and a separate agribusiness MBA offered by the School of Management. Applicants can therefore distinguish agricultural science specialisation from a management pathway.

The official undergraduate page sets out an application, entrance test and interview sequence. Its fee figures are not clearly labelled by academic year, however. The school’s events list provides dated evidence of activity: 2026 entries include crop water-use discussions, soil-quality sessions and a Pusa Krishi Vigyan Mela visit. These records show specific educational activity without establishing a standard experience for every student.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: The scholarship policy expressly includes B.Sc. Agriculture in the 70–79.99% school-mark band and lists higher merit bands. Awards cover the stated academic fee, require evidence and remain subject to limited seats and the approved offer. The published scholarship-document deadline is 31 October 2026.

schemes.name: UG academic merit scholarship including B.Sc. Agriculture
schemes.details: The agriculture-specific 70–79.99% band offers 10%; 80–87.99% offers 20%, 88–91.99% 30%, 92–94.99% 50%, and 95%+ 100% academic-fee scholarship. Only one category applies. Continuation depends on performance and the applicable policy.
schemes.eligibility: Agriculture explicitly named for the 70–79.99% band; qualifying-subject aggregation and other policy restrictions apply.
schemes.renewal: Continuation depends on qualifying-year performance and the policy; initial eligibility does not guarantee a full-course award.
schemes.documents: Original board marksheet/transcript and scholarship form with supporting evidence through the student portal by 31 October 2026.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The school refers to a career advisory and placement team for counselling. Its displayed drive and company totals do not define an agriculture graduating cohort or reporting year, so they are not reproduced as agriculture outcomes.
